name: TrustShield
_comment_offline_bundle: src/offline/offline_bundle.js needs NO manifest wiring of its own. It is a classic script with the dual CommonJS/global export (global TrustShieldOfflineBundle). The background service worker loads it with importScripts('src/offline/offline_bundle.js') alongside the other shared/logic modules, same as constants.js/domain.js/allowlist.js/signals.js -- see CONTRACT.md's background.js wiring (coordinator's job). Nothing in this extension loads offline_bundle.js from a content script or fetches it as a resource, so it does NOT need a 'web_accessible_resources' entry -- importScripts avoids that surface entirely, which is simpler and keeps the bundle out of any web-reachable path.
_comment_permissions: offline_bundle.js is pure static data (no chrome.* calls) and needs zero permissions of its own. The block below is reproduced from CONTRACT.md's fixed baseline for completeness/reference only -- child 1 is not requesting anything beyond it, and the coordinator should not treat this file as asking for more.
